subject: B-RUNTIME-LAW-01 reward K-bind FEM
body:
B-RUNTIME-LAW-01 exact contract. C exposes; ASTRA emits. Not FE256_PASS. Not PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS. Not BOARD_PASS. No learner RTL from B.

REWARD (B-01/B-02):
- Chain: pending proposal -> executed PrimitiveCommand -> ObservedEffect -> Reward Gate reward_accepted -> Q* credit.
- Causal identity (existing fields only): episode_id, step_id, command_id, generation.
- Who asserts reward_accepted=1: action-lane Reward Gate (outside Q*). Q* consumes. ASTRA status is not a reward.
- Required before assert: one pending; identities equal; exec_valid=1; ObservedEffect.accepted=1 citing command_id+episode/step; legal reward source; TRAIN not EXAM.
- Idempotency: same causal key -> at most one learner update. Credit CONSUMES the pending. Duplicate presentation = refused, no reapply.
- ONE outstanding Q* pending allowed. Overwrite while pending = observable/refused.
- C proposal (one pending; credit consumes; duplicate cannot reapply; overwrite observable/refused) is COMPATIBLE. C owns learner RTL. Do not wait.

K_SOFT (B-03):
- QueryRecord.search_budget is walker/posting work, not K_soft.
- C derives K_soft at SPEAR bind from search_budget. Numeric formula NOT FROZEN (immature; do not invent one).
- B owns validation law. Validation at SPEAR bind before ranking.
- search_budget=0 remains SEARCH_INCOMPLETE / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED 0x20, not k_invalid.

K_HARD (B-04 consume A):
- Source = same loaded board/knowledge-pack profile as ACTIVE_ID_RANGE (A K_HARD_PROFILE_OWNER). D wires. C consumes. A does not freeze the integer.
- After legal bind C may use K=min(K_soft,K_hard). min-clamp is not k_invalid.

K_INVALID mapping:
- C k_invalid=1 -> DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL 0x06 + reason K_INVALID 0x23 + completeness NOT_APPLICABLE.
- Never ANSWER, never UNKNOWN, never status 0x23. Bind fail before ranking observables. SPEAR not invoked -> N/A not 0.

FEM COMMITTED_CORRUPT (B-05):
- COMMIT present + prototype CRC invalid, integrity_fault=1.
- DATA_INTEGRITY_FAIL 0x06 + reason COMMITTED_CORRUPT 0x56 + completeness NOT_APPLICABLE.
- Never UNKNOWN. Never a valid committed prototype. Do not retire raw. Do not treat as COMMITTED_NEW.

Gold: verification/astra_adv/ (21 cases; prior 17 retained). Independent of pack_vectors.py.
